import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-11'); b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
px={s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change()
# Drawdown recovery efficiency: recovery from 30d trough, scaled by trailing 20d volatility.
# Positive values identify assets rebounding strongly from a recent trough per unit risk.
trough=P.rolling(30,min_periods=15).min(); vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(P/trough-1).div(vol.replace(0,np.nan),axis=0)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
ics=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ics.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z))
a=np.asarray(ics)
print('factor=drawdown_recovery_efficiency horizon=10 end=',end.date())
print('dates',len(a),'avg_N',round(float(np.mean(ns)),3),'IC',round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR',round(float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)),6),'hit',round(float(np.mean(a>0)),4))
print('coverage',round(float(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean()),4),'turnover',round(float(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()),4))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-01-11')]:
 q=[]
 for dt in f.loc[lo:hi].index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.asarray(q); print('regime',lo,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(float(q.mean()),6) if len(q) else None,'ICIR',round(float(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)),6) if len(q)>1 else None)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280111_drawdown_recovery_efficiency_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-11'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
px={s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change()
# Downside efficiency: cumulative return divided by downside semivariance proxy.
down=R.clip(upper=0).abs().rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()
f=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()/(down*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1; a=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:a.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic);ns.append(len(z))
a=np.asarray(a)
print('factor=downside_efficiency20 horizon=10 end=',end.date(),'dates',len(a),'avg_N',round(np.mean(ns),3),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
print('coverage',round(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),4),'turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),4))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-01-11')]:
 q=[]
 for dt in f.loc[lo:hi].index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.asarray(q); print('regime',lo,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280111_downside_efficiency20_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-04-10'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
px={s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); r3=P.pct_change(3); vol=R.rolling(20).std()
# Low-volatility-conditioned relative reversal: contrarian 3d relative return, scaled by inverse trailing 20d volatility.
rel=r3.sub(r3.median(axis=1),axis=0)
f=-rel/(vol+1e-8)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
ics=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ics.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
a=np.asarray(ics)
print('dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-04-10')]:
 q=(np.array(dates)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(dates)<=pd.Timestamp(hi)); b=a[q]
 print('REG',lo,hi,'dates',len(b),'N',np.mean(np.array(ns)[q]) if len(b) else 0,'IC',b.mean() if len(b) else np.nan,'ICIR',b.mean()/b.std(ddof=1) if len(b)>1 else np.nan,'hit',np.mean(b>0) if len(b) else np.nan)
rk=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover', (rk-rk.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),'period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
# decay horizons
for h in [1,3,5,10,20]:
 yy=P.shift(-h)/P-1; aa=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: aa.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 print('DECAY',h,np.mean(aa),np.mean(aa)/np.std(aa,ddof=1))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; end=pd.Timestamp('2028-04-10'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); v=R.rolling(20).std()
r3=P.pct_change(3); r5=P.pct_change(5)
# Smoothed inverse-vol relative reversal: average volatility-normalized 3d and 5d relative returns.
f3=-(r3-r3.median(axis=1).values[:,None])/(v+1e-8); f5=-(r5-r5.median(axis=1).values[:,None])/(v+1e-8); f=(f3+f5)/2
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1; aa=[]; nn=[]; dd=[]
for d in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],y.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: aa.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic);nn.append(len(z));dd.append(d)
a=np.array(aa);print('dates',len(a),'N',np.mean(nn),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-04-10')]:
 q=(np.array(dd)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(dd)<=pd.Timestamp(hi));b=a[q];print('REG',lo,len(b),b.mean(),b.mean()/b.std(ddof=1))
rk=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover',(rk-rk.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
for h in [1,3,5,10,20]:
 yy=P.shift(-h)/P-1; zics=[]
 for d in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],yy.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:zics.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 print('DECAY',h,np.mean(zics),np.mean(zics)/np.std(zics,ddof=1))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280411_smoothed_volnorm_reversal_signal.csv')

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2028-04-11

### Explored Factors

1. **Low-volatility-scaled relative reversal**
   - Signal:  
     `-(3-day return - cross-sectional median 3-day return) / trailing 20-day daily volatility`
   - Uses all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Intended to identify short-term contrarian opportunities while reducing exposure to high-volatility assets.
   - Signal artifact:  
     `scripts/miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Smoothed volatility-normalized relative reversal**
   - Signal: equal blend of volatility-normalized 3-day and 5-day relative reversals.
   - Signal artifact:  
     `scripts/miner_3_20280411_smoothed_volnorm_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

All tests used causal prices through 2028-04-10, at least eight valid instruments per date, and the full 15-instrument universe.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. N | Admission Horizon | Mean IC | ICIR | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Low-vol-scaled relative reversal | 2,810 | 15.00 | 3 days | 0.03866 | 0.11791 | 99.26% | 0.2035 | **Passed** |
| Smoothed 3d/5d vol-normalized reversal | 2,810 | 15.00 | 10 days | 0.02395 | 0.07430 | 99.26% | 0.1655 | Failed ICIR gate |

The low-volatility-scaled relative reversal exceeded the benchmark admission gates:

- Required absolute IC: **≥ 0.0070**
- Observed 3-day IC: **0.03866**
- Required absolute ICIR: **≥ 0.0840**
- Observed 3-day ICIR: **0.11791**

#### Low-volatility-scaled relative reversal diagnostics

- IC hit ratio: **52.67%**
- Dates evaluated: **2,810**
- Average instruments per date: **14.998**
- Coverage: **99.26%**
- Turnover: **0.2035**
- Decay:
  - 1-day IC: 0.03398, ICIR 0.10377
  - 3-day IC: 0.03866, ICIR 0.11791
  - 5-day IC: 0.03416, ICIR 0.10617
  - 10-day IC: 0.02684, ICIR 0.08281
  - 20-day IC: 0.01107, ICIR 0.03459

The factor’s predictive strength peaks around the 3-day horizon and decays gradually thereafter.

Regime diagnostics at the 10-day diagnostic horizon were positive across all broad periods:

- 2020–2022: IC **0.02404**, ICIR **0.07075**
- 2023–2024: IC **0.02989**, ICIR **0.09447**
- 2025–2026: IC **0.02871**, ICIR **0.08734**
- 2027–2028-04-10: IC **0.02530**, ICIR **0.09176**

The small cross-section means uncertainty remains material despite the long time series.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_3d.json`
- Status: **EFFECTIVE**
- Validation timestamp: **2028-04-11**
- Signal provenance included:
  `scripts/miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_signal.csv`
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: recorded as unavailable and set to `null`; deterministic library-level correlation remains subject to downstream recomputation.

The smoothed 3-day/5-day candidate was not persisted because its 10-day ICIR of **0.07430** did not meet the **0.0840** threshold.

### Current Effective Factors

The newly validated effective factor is:

- **miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_3d**
  - 3-day IC: **0.03866**
  - 3-day ICIR: **0.11791**
  - Coverage: **99.26%**
  - Turnover: **0.2035**
  - Validated: **2028-04-11**

Previously persisted miner-3 effective factors remain unchanged, including the relative-reversal, risk-momentum, volatility-scaled reversal, and intraday-reversal records noted in the prior cycle.

### Plans

- Revalidate the new factor on rolling recent windows, particularly 2027 onward, before any future refresh.
- Test whether volatility scaling remains effective when applied to 5-day or 10-day reversal horizons.
- Measure pairwise correlation against existing reversal factors using the saved signal artifacts.
- Explore conditional versions using observation-only VIX and DXY regime data while keeping all macro series non-tradable.
- Monitor turnover and overlap with the existing relative-reversal factor to avoid redundant ensemble exposure.

## Explored Factors

1. **Low-Volatility-Scaled Relative Reversal**
   - Construction:  
     `−(3-day return − cross-sectional median 3-day return) / 20-day daily volatility`
   - Motivation: identify short-term underperformers likely to rebound, while normalizing by recent risk.
   - Validation used a causal 10-trading-day forward return horizon through **2028-04-24**.

2. **Beta-Residual Reversal**
   - Construction:  
     negative 5-day asset return residual after removing exposure to the equal-weighted cross-asset benchmark.
   - Motivation: isolate idiosyncratic reversal from common market movement.
   - Validation used the same 10-trading-day forward horizon.

## Validation Results

Admission gates: absolute IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Coverage | Turnover | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Low-volatility-scaled relative reversal | 2,820 | 14.998 | 0.026633 | 0.082211 | 51.99% | 99.26% | 0.2036 | Failed ICIR gate |
| Beta-residual reversal | 2,810 | 14.998 | 0.011131 | 0.033215 | 51.25% | 98.91% | 0.1510 | Failed ICIR gate |

### Low-volatility-scaled relative reversal regimes

- **2020–2022:** IC 0.024039, ICIR 0.070745
- **2023–2024:** IC 0.029892, ICIR 0.094475
- **2025–2026:** IC 0.028712, ICIR 0.087335
- **2027–2028-04-24:** IC 0.023587, ICIR 0.085573

Its decay profile was strongest at shorter horizons:

- 1-day IC: 0.034202
- 3-day IC: 0.038760
- 5-day IC: 0.034324
- 10-day IC: 0.026633
- 20-day IC: 0.011219

Despite positive IC in each broad regime, the 10-day ICIR fell just below the required gate.

### Beta-residual reversal regimes

- **2020–2022:** IC 0.000108, ICIR 0.000316
- **2023–2024:** IC 0.033604, ICIR 0.100977
- **2025–2026:** IC 0.000467, ICIR 0.001362
- **2027–2028-04-24:** IC 0.018917, ICIR 0.063744

The factor’s predictive strength was concentrated in select regimes and was not sufficiently stable.

## Persistence Actions

- Renamed and persisted the previously effective low-volatility-scaled reversal as:
  - `factors/miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_3d_deprecated.json`
  - Status: `DEPRECATED`
  - Revalidation date: **2028-04-25**
  - Updated IC: **0.026633**
  - Updated ICIR: **0.082211**
  - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20280425_lowvol_relative_reversal_signal.csv`

- No new factor met both admission gates, so no new factor was persisted as effective.
- The deprecated factor JSON was reloaded and verified successfully.

## Current Effective Factors

The previously effective factor library remains unchanged. The low-volatility-scaled relative reversal factor is no longer effective because its refreshed ICIR failed the 0.0840 threshold.

## Plans

- Continue monitoring the deprecated reversal factor for recovery, particularly at its stronger 3–5 day horizons.
- Explore more stable orthogonal signals, including:
  - cross-asset dispersion and volatility-regime interactions,
  - robust lead-lag factors,
  - residual momentum with longer estimation windows,
  - liquidity or volume-pressure factors.
- Avoid adding further short-horizon reversal variants unless they demonstrate materially stronger 10-day ICIR and reduced overlap with the existing reversal library.

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2028-05-09

### Explored Factors

1. **Beta-residual relative reversal**
   - Construction: five-day return residualized against the equal-weighted cross-asset benchmark using a rolling 60-day beta, then cross-sectionally demeaned and negated.
   - Motivation: isolate idiosyncratic short-term reversals while reducing common benchmark exposure.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20280509_beta_residual_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Low-volatility-scaled relative three-day reversal — revalidation**
   - Construction:  
     `-(3-day return − cross-sectional median 3-day return) / trailing 20-day daily volatility`
   - Motivation: retain the established short-term contrarian signal while down-weighting highly volatile instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20280509_lowvol_relative_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

All tests used the full 15-instrument tradable universe, causal prices through **2028-05-08**, and required at least eight valid instruments per date.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. N | Horizon | Mean IC | ICIR | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Beta-residual relative reversal | 2,820 | 14.998 | 10 days | 0.01065 | 0.03181 | 98.92% | 0.1511 | **Failed** |
| Low-vol-scaled relative reversal | 2,830 | 14.998 | 3 days | 0.03931 | 0.12009 | 99.27% | 0.2037 | **Passed** |

Admission thresholds were absolute daily paper IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

#### Beta-residual relative reversal

The factor passed the IC magnitude threshold at the tested 10-day horizon but failed the ICIR requirement. Predictive strength was also uneven by regime:

- 2020–2022: IC 0.00011, ICIR 0.00032
- 2023–2024: IC 0.03360, ICIR 0.10098
- 2025–2026: IC 0.00047, ICIR 0.00136
- 2027–2028-05: IC 0.01475, ICIR 0.04982

Decay was positive at shorter horizons but weak:

- 1-day IC 0.02446, ICIR 0.06940
- 3-day IC 0.01992, ICIR 0.05846
- 5-day IC 0.01626, ICIR 0.04894
- 20-day IC -0.00508, ICIR -0.01507

Not persisted.

#### Low-volatility-scaled relative reversal

The revalidated factor remains above both admission gates at its strongest, three-day horizon:

- 3-day IC: **0.03931**
- 3-day ICIR: **0.12009**
- IC hit ratio: 53.40%
- Coverage: 99.27%
- Turnover: 0.2037

Decay profile:

- 1-day IC 0.03442, ICIR 0.10530
- 3-day IC 0.03931, ICIR 0.12009
- 5-day IC 0.03447, ICIR 0.10730
- 10-day IC 0.02649, ICIR 0.08187
- 20-day IC 0.01121, ICIR 0.03506

The factor’s mean IC remained positive across all broad regimes, although the recent regime showed weaker stability at the 10-day diagnostic horizon. The small cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.

### Persistence Actions

Updated and verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_3d.json`
- Status: **EFFECTIVE**
- Version: `20280509_revalidated`
- Validation timestamp: **2028-05-09**
- Signal provenance included
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`; downstream deterministic correlation recomputation remains required

The JSON was reloaded successfully and confirmed to contain the required factor ID, effective status, validation metrics, thresholds, and signal artifact.

The beta-residual reversal candidate was not persisted because its ICIR failed the admission gate.

### Current Effective Factors

The factor validated in this cycle is currently effective:

- **miner_3_20280411_lowvol_relative_reversal_3d**
  - 3-day IC: 0.03931
  - 3-day ICIR: 0.12009
  - Coverage: 99.27%
  - Turnover: 0.2037
  - Last validated: 2028-05-09

Previously effective miner factors remain subject to library-level correlation checks and periodic revalidation.

### Plans

- Test shorter-horizon beta-residual variants with more stable volatility and beta estimation.
- Explore conditional reversal signals using observation-only VIX and DXY regime states.
- Compute deterministic pairwise correlations between the refreshed factor artifact and existing reversal factors.
- Continue monitoring the low-volatility-scaled reversal for recent-regime decay and redundancy in the ensemble.

## Explored Factors

1. **Twenty-Day Downside-Volatility-Adjusted Trend**
   - Construction: `20-day return / 20-day downside volatility`
   - Downside volatility is calculated from negative daily returns only.
   - Motivation: identify assets with efficient positive trends relative to their downside risk, while reducing signal turnover and avoiding reliance on future data.
   - Validation used completed daily bars through **2028-05-22** and a causal 10-trading-day forward-return horizon.

## Validation Results

Admission gates: absolute daily paper IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Coverage | Turnover | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 20-day downside-volatility-adjusted trend | 2,840 | 14.998 | 0.028510 | 0.090947 | 53.06% | 99.27% | 0.081468 | **Passed** |

### Regime results

- **2020–2022:** IC 0.068719, ICIR 0.222487
- **2023–2024:** IC -0.001483, ICIR -0.004759
- **2025–2026:** IC 0.032896, ICIR 0.098886
- **2027–2028-05-22:** IC -0.040498, ICIR -0.148194

The factor passes the benchmark-wide aggregate gates across 2,840 dates and nearly the full 15-instrument universe. However, its recent regime performance is negative, so it should be used cautiously and diversified against reversal and defensive signals.

### Decay

- 1-day IC: -0.013166
- 3-day IC: -0.004894
- 5-day IC: 0.005933
- 10-day IC: 0.028510
- 20-day IC: 0.050578

Predictive power strengthens over longer horizons, consistent with the factor’s trend-following construction and low turnover.

- **miner_3_20280523_downside_efficiency_20d**

Previously effective factors remain subject to the existing library and ensemble-selection process. The low-volatility-scaled relative reversal remains deprecated following its prior ICIR failure.

- Revalidate the factor periodically and deprecate it if aggregate IC or ICIR falls below admission thresholds.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-06-05'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
px={s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change()
# Acceleration reversal: fade recent 3d move relative to prior 12d trend, scaled by 20d volatility.
r3=P.pct_change(3); r12=P.pct_change(12); vol=R.rolling(20).std()
f=-(r3-r12/4)/(vol+1e-8); y=P.shift(-10)/P-1

def calc(yy):
  ics=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
  for dt in f.index:
    z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
      ics.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
  a=np.asarray(ics); return a,ns,ds

a,ns,ds=calc(y); print('ALL dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-06-05')]:
 q=(np.array(ds)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(ds)<=pd.Timestamp(hi)); b=a[q]; print('REG',lo,hi,'dates',len(b),'N',np.mean(np.array(ns)[q]),'IC',b.mean(),'ICIR',b.mean()/b.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(b>0))
rk=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover',(rk-rk.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-04-10'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
px={s:pd.read_csv(base/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change()
# Causal acceleration reversal: fade the recent 3-day impulse versus its preceding 12-day daily trend, risk scaled.
r3=P.pct_change(3); r12=P.pct_change(12); vol=R.rolling(20).std()
f=-(r3-r12/4)/(vol+1e-8); y=P.shift(-10)/P-1

def calc(yy):
  ics=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
  for dt in f.index:
    z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
      ics.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
  a=np.asarray(ics); return a,ns,ds
a,ns,ds=calc(y)
print('ALL dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-04-10')]:
 q=(np.array(ds)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(ds)<=pd.Timestamp(hi)); b=a[q]; print('REG',lo,hi,'dates',len(b),'N',np.mean(np.array(ns)[q]),'IC',b.mean(),'ICIR',b.mean()/b.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(b>0))
rk=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover',(rk-rk.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
for h in [1,3,5,10,20]:
 aa,_,_=calc(P.shift(-h)/P-1); print('DECAY',h,'IC',aa.mean(),'ICIR',aa.mean()/aa.std(ddof=1))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280411_acceleration_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-07-03'); b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); bench=R.mean(axis=1)
cov=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bench); var=bench.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(); beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
resid=P.pct_change(5)-beta.mul(bench.rolling(5).sum(),axis=0)
f=-resid.sub(resid.median(axis=1),axis=0); y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
A=[];N=[];D=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:A.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic);N.append(len(z));D.append(dt)
a=np.array(A);print('ALL',len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-07-03')]:
 q=(np.array(D)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(D)<=pd.Timestamp(hi));c=a[q];print('REG',lo,len(c),np.mean(c),np.mean(c)/np.std(c,ddof=1),np.mean(c>0))
r=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover',(r-r.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean());f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280704_beta_residual_reversal_signal.csv')
for h in [1,3,5,10,20]:
 yy=P.shift(-h)/P-1;q=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.array(q); print('DECAY',h,np.mean(q),np.mean(q)/np.std(q,ddof=1),len(q))
print('period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-07-03'); b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); bench=R.mean(axis=1)
cov=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bench); var=bench.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(); beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
# Short-horizon idiosyncratic reversal: fade 3-day beta-adjusted residual move.
resid=P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bench.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0); f=-resid.sub(resid.median(axis=1),axis=0); y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
A=[];N=[];D=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:A.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic);N.append(len(z));D.append(dt)
a=np.array(A);print('ALL',len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-07-03')]:
 q=(np.array(D)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(D)<=pd.Timestamp(hi));c=a[q];print('REG',lo,len(c),np.mean(c),np.mean(c)/np.std(c,ddof=1),np.mean(c>0))
r=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover',(r-r.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean());f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280704_beta_residual3_reversal_signal.csv')
for h in [1,3,5,10,20]:
 yy=P.shift(-h)/P-1;q=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.array(q); print('DECAY',h,np.mean(q),np.mean(q)/np.std(q,ddof=1),len(q))
print('period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2028-07-04

### Explored Factors

1. **Three-day beta-residual cross-asset reversal**
   - Construction: fade the asset-specific component of each instrument’s 3-day return after removing exposure to the equal-weight universe benchmark using a 60-day rolling beta.
   - Signal:  
     `-(3-day asset return − 60-day rolling beta × 3-day benchmark return)`
   - Motivation: isolate short-term idiosyncratic moves and capture cross-asset mean reversion while reducing common-market effects.
   - Uses only data available through **2028-07-03**.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20280704_beta_residual3_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Five-day beta-residual reversal**
   - Construction: analogous beta-adjusted residual reversal using a 5-day return window.
   - Result: positive 10-day IC, but insufficient ICIR for admission.

| Validation period | 2020-01-01 to 2028-07-03 |

- 2025–2026: IC 0.01568, ICIR 0.04634

Decay profile:

| Forward horizon | IC | ICIR |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 day | 0.02165 | 0.06143 |
| 3 days | 0.02213 | 0.06644 |
| 5 days | 0.01849 | 0.05568 |
| 10 days | **0.02084** | **0.06233** |
| 20 days | 0.00614 | 0.01841 |

The factor is positive across all tested regimes and has useful persistence through the 10-day horizon. The small 15-instrument cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.

#### Five-day beta-residual reversal

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-07-03'); b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); bench=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bench).div(bench.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
res=P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bench.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)
idvol=(R-beta.mul(bench,axis=0)).rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()
f=-res/idvol
f=f.sub(f.median(axis=1),axis=0); y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
A=[];N=[];D=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:A.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic);N.append(len(z));D.append(dt)
a=np.array(A);print('ALL',len(a),np.mean(N),a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),np.mean(a>0))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022-12-31'),('2023','2024-12-31'),('2025','2026-12-31'),('2027','2028-07-03')]:
 q=(np.array(D)>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(np.array(D)<=pd.Timestamp(hi));c=a[q];print('REG',lo,len(c),np.mean(c),np.mean(c)/np.std(c,ddof=1),np.mean(c>0))
r=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('coverage',f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).mean(),'turnover',(r-r.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280718_residual_volnorm3_signal.csv')
for h in [1,3,5,10,20]:
 yy=P.shift(-h)/P-1;q=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],yy.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:q.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.array(q);print('DECAY',h,np.mean(q),np.mean(q)/np.std(q,ddof=1),len(q))
print('period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())

## Explored Factors

1. **Beta-residual 3-day reversal**
   - Construction: subtract each asset’s estimated 60-day beta exposure to the equal-weighted benchmark from its three-day return, then negate the cross-sectional demeaned residual.
   - Motivation: capture idiosyncratic short-term mean reversion while removing broad market movement.

2. **Beta-residual volatility-normalized 3-day reversal**
   - Construction: divide the beta-adjusted three-day residual return by trailing 20-day idiosyncratic volatility, then negate and cross-sectionally demean.
   - Motivation: improve comparability across assets with very different volatility levels.

3. **Previously persisted acceleration-reversal factor refresh**
   - Rechecked the existing volatility-scaled acceleration-reversal implementation as a benchmark for comparison.

## Validation Results

Validation used the 15 tradable benchmark instruments, causal prices through **2028-07-03**, and a 10-trading-day forward-return horizon. Each date required at least 8 valid instruments.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Coverage | Turnover | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Beta-residual 3d reversal | 2,860 | 14.998 | 0.020841 | 0.062333 | 98.93% | 0.1918 | **Failed ICIR gate** |
| Beta-residual volatility-normalized 3d reversal | 2,851 | 14.701 | 0.016042 | 0.050342 | 98.62% | 0.1983 | **Failed ICIR gate** |
| Existing acceleration reversal benchmark | 2,850 | 14.998 | 0.030503 | 0.098425 | 99.27% | 0.2031 | **Effective** |

Admission gates: absolute daily paper IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

### Beta-residual 3d reversal regimes

- 2020–2022: IC 0.016951, ICIR 0.048781
- 2023–2024: IC 0.030604, ICIR 0.093154
- 2025–2026: IC 0.015676, ICIR 0.046337
- 2027–2028-07-03: IC 0.022223, ICIR 0.074080

The signal was directionally positive across regimes but lacked sufficient stability.

### Volatility-normalized beta-residual reversal regimes

- 2020–2022: IC 0.010964, ICIR 0.033109
- 2023–2024: IC 0.020700, ICIR 0.066454
- 2025–2026: IC 0.011194, ICIR 0.034802
- 2027–2028-07-03: IC 0.029817, ICIR 0.102434

Recent performance improved, but aggregate ICIR remained well below the admission threshold.

### Decay: volatility-normalized beta-residual reversal

- 1-day IC: 0.019554
- 3-day IC: 0.021056
- 5-day IC: 0.017071
- 10-day IC: 0.016042
- 20-day IC: 0.004048

Predictive power decayed materially by 20 days and did not demonstrate adequate stability at the required horizon.

## Persistence Actions

- **No new factor persisted.**
- Both beta-residual candidates failed the ICIR admission gate.
- Signal artifacts were generated for audit:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20280704_beta_residual3_reversal_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20280718_residual_volnorm3_signal.csv`
- No factor was marked effective or deprecated as a result of this cycle.
- Existing effective factors remain unchanged.

## Current Effective Factors

The previously effective acceleration-reversal factor remains effective:

- **`miner_3_20280606_acceleration_reversal_10d`**
  - IC: 0.030503
  - ICIR: 0.098425
  - Coverage: 99.27%
  - Turnover: 0.2031
  - Last validated: 2028-06-06

Other library factors remain subject to ensemble selection and deterministic library-correlation checks.

## Plans

- Avoid adding the beta-residual variants unless future revalidation materially improves ICIR.
- Explore lower-turnover residual signals using five-day residual windows and longer volatility estimation windows.
- Test conditional residual reversal only during elevated cross-asset dispersion or volatility regimes.
- Continue monitoring the existing acceleration-reversal factor for performance drift after the recent mixed live blocks.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2028-07-31'); b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:end].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); bench=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bench).div(bench.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2028-08-01

### Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-normalized three-day beta-residual reversal**
   - Signal: negative three-day asset return residual after removing 60-day rolling beta exposure to the equal-weight 15-asset benchmark, divided by 20-day residual volatility.
   - 10-day IC: 0.01504
   - 10-day ICIR: 0.04725
   - Result: failed the ICIR admission gate.

2. **Multi-horizon beta-residual reversal blend**
   - Construction: equal-ranked blend of one-, three-, and five-day beta-residual reversal signals.
   - 10-day IC: 0.02032
   - 10-day ICIR: 0.06142
   - Result: failed the ICIR admission gate.

3. **Bull-regime conditional three-day beta-residual reversal**
   - Construction: apply the three-day beta-residual reversal only when the trailing five-day equal-weight benchmark return is positive; remain inactive during non-positive benchmark regimes.
   - Motivation: prior validation showed substantially stronger reversal effectiveness in positive benchmark regimes and negligible effectiveness in bearish regimes.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Valid IC dates | Avg. instruments | 10-day IC | 10-day ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Volatility-normalized residual reversal | 2,871 | 14.69 | 0.01504 | 0.04725 | 50.92% | 98.63% | Failed ICIR |
| 1/3/5-day residual blend | 2,880 | 15.00 | 0.02032 | 0.06142 | 52.05% | Broad | Failed ICIR |
| Bull-regime conditional residual reversal | 1,699 | 14.99 | **0.03386** | **0.10072** | 53.91% | 58.30% unconditional | **Passed** |

Conditional regime comparison:

- Positive benchmark regime: IC 0.03386, ICIR 0.10072, 1,699 dates.
- Non-positive benchmark regime: IC -0.00042, ICIR -0.00127, 1,181 dates.

The conditional factor exceeds both benchmark-wide admission gates:

- Absolute IC threshold: 0.0070
- Absolute ICIR threshold: 0.0840

The 15-instrument universe and conditional coverage require conservative interpretation. Library correlation remains subject to deterministic post-Miner recomputation; persisted metadata reports `max_abs_library_correlation: null`.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and successfully reloaded:

- `factors/miner_3_20280801_conditional_beta_residual3_reversal_10d.json`
- Factor ID: `miner_3_20280801_conditional_beta_residual3_reversal_10d`

The JSON was read back and verified for factor ID, required definition fields, validation status, thresholds, signal artifact, and provenance.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **miner_3_20280801_conditional_beta_residual3_reversal_10d**
  - IC: 0.03386
  - ICIR: 0.10072
  - Valid dates: 1,699
  - Average instruments: 14.99
  - Unconditional coverage: 58.30%
  - Validated: 2028-08-01

Previously effective factors remain subject to scheduled revalidation and deterministic library-correlation checks.

### Plans

- Monitor overlap with existing beta-residual, relative-reversal, and volatility-normalized reversal factors.
- Investigate robust regime definitions using volatility or macro stress signals without reducing coverage excessively.
- Revalidate the new conditional factor after approximately three months.
- Avoid admitting the volatility-normalized and multi-horizon blend variants unless their ICIR improves above the required threshold.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-08-14'].ffill()
R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1); beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
f=-(P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0))
# Only express signal after a positive trailing five-day benchmark regime.
f[bm.rolling(5).sum()<=0]=np.nan
rows=[]
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1: rows.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
a=np.array([x[1] for x in rows]); dates=[x[0] for x in rows]
# turnover among active signals, day-over-day normalized rank changes
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turnover=rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[dates].mean()
print('dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean([pd.concat([f.loc[d],y.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna().shape[0] for d in dates]),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',turnover)
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022'),('2023','2024'),('2025','2026'),('2027','2028-08-14')]:
 q=a[[str(d.date())[:4]>=lo and str(d.date())[:4]<=hi[:4] for d in dates]]
 print(lo,hi,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280815_conditional_beta_residual3_up_signal.csv')
print('artifact written')

## Explored Factors

   - Construction: negate each asset’s three-day return residual after removing its 60-day rolling beta exposure to the equal-weighted 15-asset benchmark.
   - Activation: signal is active only when the benchmark’s trailing five-day return is positive.
   - Motivation: capture short-term idiosyncratic mean reversion during constructive market regimes while avoiding exposure during broad risk-off periods.

2. **Unconditional beta-residual reversal refresh**
   - The unconditional version was rechecked as a benchmark.
   - It remained directionally positive but failed the required stability threshold.

3. **Residual blends and alternative horizons**
   - Tested residual blends and horizon variations.
   - These produced weaker IC/ICIR than the conditional candidate and were not persisted.

## Validation Results

Validation used the 15 tradable benchmark instruments, causal prices through **2028-08-14**, and a 10-trading-day forward-return horizon. Each active date had at least 8 valid instruments.

| Factor | Dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Coverage | Turnover | Status |

- Absolute IC ≥ **0.0070**
- Absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**

- **2023–2024:** IC 0.02119, ICIR 0.06345, 445 dates
- **2025–2026:** IC 0.02388, ICIR 0.07084, 417 dates
- **2027–2028-08-14:** IC 0.01745, ICIR 0.05668, 229 dates

The factor produced positive IC in every calendar regime. Its conditional activation results in lower overall signal coverage; the reported 58.21% is the fraction of asset-date observations with an active, valid signal. Active dates retained the full 15-instrument cross-section on average.

`max_abs_library_correlation` was not computed in this cycle and is recorded as `null`; deterministic library-correlation recomputation remains required downstream.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-08-28'].ffill()
R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
res=P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)
f=-res
# Bull and quiet benchmark regime: positive 5d return and 20d vol below trailing 252d median.
bull=bm.rolling(5).sum()>0
vol=bm.rolling(20).std()
quiet=vol < vol.rolling(252,min_periods=126).median()
f[~(bull & quiet)]=np.nan
rows=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  rows.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z))
a=np.asarray(rows); dates=[d for d in f.index if d in []]
print('dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
# regime/year stability
valid=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1: valid.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022'),('2023','2024'),('2025','2026'),('2027','2028')]:
 q=np.array([v for d,v in valid if lo<=str(d.year)<=hi[:4]])
 print(lo,hi,'n',len(q),'IC',q.mean() if len(q) else np.nan,'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280829_bull_quiet_residual3_signal.csv')
print('artifact written')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-09-11'].ffill()
R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
res=P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)
f=-res
# Positive benchmark trend plus high cross-sectional dispersion; all regime inputs available at t.
disp=R.rolling(20).std(axis=1)
high=disp > disp.rolling(252,min_periods=126).median()
bull=bm.rolling(5).sum()>0
f[~(bull & high)]=np.nan
rows=[]; ns=[]; valid=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  rows.append(ic); ns.append(len(z)); valid.append((dt,ic))
a=np.asarray(rows)
print('dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for lo,hi in [(2020,2022),(2023,2024),(2025,2026),(2027,2028)]:
 q=np.array([v for d,v in valid if lo<=d.year<=hi]); print(f'{lo}-{hi}','n',len(q),'IC',q.mean() if len(q) else np.nan,'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280912_bull_highdisp_residual3_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-09-11'].ffill()
R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
res=P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)
f=-res
# Positive benchmark trend plus high cross-sectional dispersion; all regime inputs available at t.
disp=R.rolling(20).std().mean(axis=1)
high=disp > disp.rolling(252,min_periods=126).median()
bull=bm.rolling(5).sum()>0
f[~(bull & high)]=np.nan
rows=[]; ns=[]; valid=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
  rows.append(ic); ns.append(len(z)); valid.append((dt,ic))
a=np.asarray(rows)
print('dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for lo,hi in [(2020,2022),(2023,2024),(2025,2026),(2027,2028)]:
 q=np.array([v for d,v in valid if lo<=d.year<=hi]); print(f'{lo}-{hi}','n',len(q),'IC',q.mean() if len(q) else np.nan,'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280912_bull_highdisp_residual3_signal.csv')
print('artifact written')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-09-20'].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0); vol=bm.rolling(20).std(); q75=vol.rolling(252,min_periods=126).quantile(.75)
f=-(P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)); f[(bm.rolling(5).sum()<=0)|(vol>=q75)]=np.nan
rows=[]; ns=[]; valid=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic; rows.append(ic); ns.append(len(z)); valid.append((dt,ic))
a=np.array(rows); print('dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),3),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for lo,hi in [(2020,2022),(2023,2024),(2025,2026),(2027,2028)]:
 q=np.array([v for d,v in valid if lo<=d.year<=hi]); print(f'{lo}-{hi}','n',len(q),'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],P.shift(-h).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1: rr.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.array(rr); print('decay',h,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280921_bull_q75_residual3_signal.csv')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-08-28'].ffill()
R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
y=P.shift(-10)/P-1
res=P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)
f=-res
# Bull and quiet benchmark regime: positive 5d return and 20d vol below trailing 252d median.
bull=bm.rolling(5).sum()>0
vol=bm.rolling(20).std()
quiet=vol < vol.rolling(252,min_periods=126).median()
f[~(bull & quiet)]=np.nan
rows=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  rows.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z))
a=np.asarray(rows); dates=[d for d in f.index if d in []]
print('dates',len(a),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
# regime/year stability
valid=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1: valid.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2022'),('2023','2024'),('2025','2026'),('2027','2028')]:
 q=np.array([v for d,v in valid if lo<=str(d.year)<=hi[:4]])
 print(lo,hi,'n',len(q),'IC',q.mean() if len(q) else np.nan,'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280829_bull_quiet_residual3_signal.csv')
print('artifact written')
"}

## Explored Factors

1. **Bull-high-dispersion beta-residual 3D reversal**
   - Negative three-day beta-residual return.
   - Activated when the equal-weighted benchmark had positive five-day momentum and high cross-sectional volatility.
   - Failed admission: IC **0.00618**, ICIR **0.01829**.

2. **Bull-regime beta-residual 3D reversal with Q75 volatility filter**
   - Negative three-day beta-residual return.
   - Activated when benchmark five-day return was positive and 20-day benchmark volatility was below its trailing 252-day 75th percentile.
   - Designed to broaden coverage relative to the prior bull-quiet median-volatility filter while retaining a constructive regime condition.

## Validation Results

Validation used causal prices through **2028-09-11**, the full 15-instrument tradable universe, and a 10-trading-day forward-return horizon. Every valid date had all 15 instruments available.

| Factor | Valid dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage | Turnover | Status |

| Bull-high-dispersion residual reversal | 785 | 15.0 | 0.00618 | 0.01829 | 49.81% | 26.60% | 0.1821 | Failed |
| Bull-Q75-volatility residual reversal | 1,263 | 15.0 | 0.03133 | 0.09354 | 53.29% | 42.90% | 0.1814 | **Passed** |

Admission thresholds were absolute IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

### Regime stability of the accepted factor

- **2020–2022:** IC 0.05540, ICIR 0.15845, 435 dates
- **2023–2024:** IC 0.01721, ICIR 0.05286, 324 dates
- **2025–2026:** IC 0.02934, ICIR 0.08786, 324 dates
- **2027–2028-09-11:** IC 0.00218, ICIR 0.00691, 180 dates

The aggregate result passes the benchmark-wide gate, but predictive strength is weak in the most recent regime. This factor should therefore receive restrained ensemble weight and be treated as a conditional diversifier rather than a standalone signal.

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
b=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(b/f'{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index() for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:'2028-09-20'].ffill(); R=P.pct_change(); bm=R.mean(axis=1)
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0); vol=bm.rolling(20).std(); q75=vol.rolling(252,min_periods=126).quantile(.75)
f=-(P.pct_change(3)-beta.mul(bm.rolling(3).sum(),axis=0)); f[(bm.rolling(5).sum()<=0)|(vol>=q75)]=np.nan
rows=[]; ns=[]; valid=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],P.shift(-10).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic; rows.append(ic); ns.append(len(z)); valid.append((dt,ic))
a=np.array(rows); print('dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),3),'IC',a.mean(),'ICIR',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(a>0),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for lo,hi in [(2020,2022),(2023,2024),(2025,2026),(2027,2028)]:
 q=np.array([v for d,v in valid if lo<=d.year<=hi]); print(f'{lo}-{hi}','n',len(q),'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 rr=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],P.shift(-h).loc[dt]/P.loc[dt]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1: rr.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 q=np.array(rr); print('decay',h,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280921_bull_q75_residual3_signal.csv')
"}
